questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 94 years. 8 years ago their respective ages were in the ratio of 2 ∶ 1. After 10 years what will be the ratio of ages of father and son?
questions.solution:
Given:

8 year ago the ratio of age of father and his son was 2 : 1

Calculation:

Let the father and son age be 2x and 1x respectivily

Present age of father and son is (2x + 8) and (x + 8) respectivily

According to question,

(2x + 8) + (x + 8) = 94

⇒ 3x + 16 = 94

⇒ x = 26

Present age of father = (2x + 8) = 60 years and present age of son = (x + 8) = 34 years

After 10 years, father = 60 + 10 = 70 years and son = 34 + 10 = 44 years

∴ After 7 years the ratio of ages of father and son = 70 : 44 = 35 : 22

Distance between A and B = 220 km

A starts moving towards B at 11 AM with speed of 40 km/hr

B starts moving Away from A at 12 PM with speed of 30 km/hr

At 12 PM A travelled 40 km

Now distance reduced to 180 km

Now both starts moving and difference between their speed is 10 km/hr

Since A’s speed is 10 km more than B so they will meet after 180 km / 10 km/hr = 18 hr = at 6 AM on next day

questions.question: A man earns a profit of 20 percent by selling a calculator for a certain price. If he sells that calculator at double the price, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Cost Price (CP) be 100 units.

Selling Price (SP) with 20% profit = 120 units.

New Selling Price = Double the initial SP = 120 × 2 = 240 units.

New Profit = New SP − CP = 240 − 100 = 140 units.

Profit % = (140 ÷ 100) × 100 = 140%.

**∴ The correct answer is 140%.**

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100<

questions.question: Rama alone can do a work in 5 days working 4 hours a day. Seema alone can do the same work in 3 days working 10 hours a day. How many hours do they need to work together in a day to complete the same work in 6 days?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Rama can finish the work in 5 days working 4 hours a day, that's 5 × 4 = 20 hours.

Seema can finish the work in 3 days working 10 hours a day, that's 3 × 10 = 30 hours.

So, we can say that Rama's work rate is 1/20 of the work per hour, and Seema's work rate is 1/30 of the work per hour.

So, their combined rate is 1/20 + 1/30 = (3 + 2)/60 = 5/60 = 1/12 of the work per hour.

If they want to finish the work in 6 days, and they work together at the combined rate of 1/12 of the work per hour, then they need to work:

6 days × x hours/day = 1 work

x = 1 work / (6 days &a
mp;times; 1/12 work/hour)

x = 1 / (6/12) = 2 hours/day

**So, Rama and Seema need to work together for 2 hours each day to finish the work in 6 days.**

questions.question: In an examination, 45 percent of students passed in history and 60 percent of students passed in Hindi. If 8 percent of students failed in both subjects, then what percentage of students passed in both subjects?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let's denote the total number of students as 100% 

The students who passed in history are 45% and those who passed in Hindi are 60%.

So, the total percentage who passed either in history or Hindi (or both) is 45% + 60% = 105%.

But this sum also includes the students who passed in both subjects twice (once for history and once for Hindi).

Also, we know that 8% of students failed in both subjects. That means the total percentage of students who passed in at least one subject is 100% - 8% = 92%.

Percentage of students who passed in both subjects = Total pass percentage in history or Hindi - the percentage of students who passed in at least one subject

= 105% - 92% = 13%

**So, 13% of students passed in both subjects.**

r = radius

h = height

And height be 2y and 3y

Ratio = π(6x)²2y : π(5x)23y

⇒ 72x2y : 75x2y

questions.question: A sum amounts to Rs. 6580 in 2 years and amounts to Rs. 7896 in 3 years on compound interest (compounding annually) at the same rate of interest. What is the annual rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

If the sum amounts to Rs. 6580 in 2 years and Rs. 7896 in 3 years, the difference (Rs. 7896 - Rs. 6580 = Rs. 1316) would be the interest earned in the third year.

So, the interest for the third year, Rs. 1316, was obtained from the amount that was there at the end of two years, which is Rs. 6580.

Interest for third year = Sum after 2 years × annual interest rate

1316 = 6580 × r

Solving this equation for r gives us:

r = 1316/6580 × 100 = 20%

**So, the annual rate of interest is 20%.**
